sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (Common Law commercial and financial services framework derived from English Common Law and Commonwealth company law models, with French Civil Law and Melanesian customary law influences; no sub-state tax distinction)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: PACER Plus (Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus) — in force for Vanuatu
EU–Pacific States Interim Economic Partnership Agreement (iEPA)

No comprehensive Bilateral Investment Treaties or Double Tax Agreements currently in force; Vanuatu maintains Tax Information Exchange Agreements with Australia and New Zealand and participates in AEOI/CRS exchange mechanisms

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 12 of 2017 (as amended); Financial Intelligence Unit Act [Cap 220] (as amended); International Companies Act [Cap 222], including International Companies (Amendment) Act 2012 provisions on registers, records, and beneficial ownership obligations; Vanuatu Financial Services Commission Act No. 35 of 2017; VFSC AML/CFT Rules for Trust and Company Service Providers; United Nations Sanctions (Implementation) Act (as amended).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of passport (identity page) of each settlor, director, and beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport-issuing national authority of the holder's country
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or consular legalization where the country of origin is not a party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement dated within 90 days)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or issuing bank in the country of residence

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference or professional reference letter confirming identity, reputation, and source of funds
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Correspondent or relationship bank of the beneficial owner or settlor

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incorporation and register of directors and beneficial owners of any corporate shareholder (if applicable)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry of the shareholder's jurisdiction of incorporation

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all directors, shareholders, beneficial owners, and authorized signatories against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UK HMT Sanctions List, and domestic designated-person lists maintained by FIU Vanuatu, prior to engagement and periodically thereafter. PEP status is determined under FATF-aligned standards covering politically exposed persons, their family members, and close associates; any PEP relationship triggers enhanced due diligence, independent verification of source of funds and source of wealth, and senior management approval in accordance with the AML/CFT Act No. 12 of 2017 and VFSC TCSP Rules. Positive or ambiguous screening results must be escalated to the Compliance Officer and the licensed Registered Agent before name reservation is filed; confirmed adverse hits result in declination of engagement or lawful reporting to FIU Vanuatu.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — Company Name Reservation and Register (online name search and filing portal administered by VFSC Registry at vfsc.vu, in cooperation with licensed registered agents)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The registered name must be entered in the Roman/Latin alphabet; English, French, and Bislama words are permitted, but characters outside the Latin script are not accepted in the register. A Vanuatu International Company must carry a status indicator, normally the words 'International Company' or the abbreviations 'IC' / 'I.C.', or another suffix indicating limited liability acceptable to the Registrar, and the name must not be identical or deceptively similar to any existing registered or reserved name. Non-Latin script names require certified transliteration into Latin script lodged by the licensed Registered Agent.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: and their French or Bislama equivalents — such tokens require prior ministerial consent or sector regulator approval
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant, acting through its licensed Vanuatu Registered Agent, must file a written reconsideration request with the VFSC Registrar of Companies within 14 calendar days of the rejection notice, stating the statutory basis for acceptability, distinctiveness, and any consents obtained from the Minister or sector regulator for sensitive tokens. If the reconsideration is denied, the applicant may pursue an administrative appeal to the VFSC Board or a judicial review application before the Supreme Court of Vanuatu under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] and the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission Act No. 35 of 2017. A rejected name may be revised and resubmitted without penalty; reservation priority is lost only if the 30-day reservation window expires unextended.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted. Every International Company must maintain a registered office in Vanuatu, which may be the licensed address of its VFSC-licensed Registered Agent; no physical employee premises, lease, or equipment are statutorily required for this offshore, license-free, consumer micro-SaaS scope. The Registered Agent is responsible for physical custody of statutory records, registers, and AML/CFT files. The International Companies (Economic Substance) Act 2019 does not impose a relevant-activity presence obligation for ISIC 6201 software subscription services conducted outside Vanuatu, provided no Vanuatu-sourced income is derived and the tax-exempt status of the International Company is preserved.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified as LOW: approximately 2–5% probability of unannounced on-site inspection by VFSC or the licensed Registered Agent's internal compliance function in the first twelve months for a verified low-risk, non-licensed SaaS operation. The probability increases materially only if the IC engages in local business activity, holds client funds, or generates Vanuatu-source revenue, none of which is present in the current business scope.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Vanuatu International Companies Act [Cap. 222] (Act No. 33 of 1992), ss. 5–12 (incorporation, constitution, registered office and registered agent), ss. 24–29 (shares and capital), and Schedule 1 (permitted exemptions); applying regulations under the Financial Services Commission Act [Cap. 258].
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), International Companies Registry, Bougainville House, Rue de Chartreux, Port Vila, Vanuatu
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Registration of an International Company (Form IC-1), accompanied by the Company Constitution and executed consents of Registered Agent, Director, and Secretary
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; incorporation is valid with a single share of no par value (or nominal par value). No escrow, capital deposit, or capital verification requirement under the IC Act; shares may be issued to non-resident beneficial owners without VFSC approval.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: That upon issue of the Certificate of Incorporation, the Company (i) accepts subscriptions for 100 ordinary no-par-value shares at US$1.00 each from the founding subscriber, comprising the entire issued share capital; (ii) adopts the licensed registered agent's premises in Port Vila, Vanuatu as the Company's registered office and confirms the agent's statutory appointment; (iii) appoints [Director Name] as sole Director and [Secretary Name] as Company Secretary, each to hold office until the next annual general meeting; and (iv) authorizes the Director to open corporate bank and SaaS merchant accounts with approved payment providers, including Paddle and Lemon Squeezy, and to execute all documents required to implement this resolution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name Search and Reservation with VFSC
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), International Companies Registry, Port Vila (online e-Registry portal or physical counter)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name availability inquiry proposing up to three corporate names ending with a permissible designator such as Limited, Corporation, Incorporated, or Ltd. VFSC screens proposed names against the restricted and undesirable names list, including names implying government patronage, banking, insurance, or trust business. Upon approval, reserve the chosen name for a 30-day period and obtain a reservation receipt.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused, file a written objection with the VFSC Registrar stating distinctive merit; alternatively, amend the proposed name and re-submit, or proceed with an alternative name from the reservation list. Refusal grounds are published and appealable by way of a formal letter to the Registrar within 14 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Engagement of Licensed Registered Agent and Preparation of Formation Dossier
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC-licensed registered agent and corporate service provider in Port Vila, Vanuatu
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute an engagement letter with a licensed registered agent who is statutorily required to maintain the Company's registered office and corporate records in Vanuatu. Undertake customer due diligence (passport, proof of residence, source of funds, and beneficial ownership declaration). Instruct the agent to draft the Company Constitution, consent to act forms, and share subscription documents, and to perfect the statutory declaration for filing.
required_dossiers: Passport or national ID copy of each shareholder and director
Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement)
Banker's reference or professional KYC letter (optional but recommended)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the agent raises a CDD deficiency, provide notarized or apostilled supporting documents or a bank attestation within 5 business days. If the agent declines the engagement, select another VFSC-licensed agent and transfer the preliminary documents without loss of any reservation or fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Incorporation Application and Payment of Statutory Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), International Companies Registry, filing desk
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File Form IC-1 together with the signed Constitution, consents of the Registered Agent, Director and Secretary, and the subscriber's share subscription agreement. Pay the official state filing fee via bank transfer or VFSC-accepted e-payment. Select standard processing or expedited processing where available. The Registrar examines the application against IC Act formalities and, if satisfied, issues the Certificate of Incorporation bearing the Company's registration number.
required_dossiers: Consent to act as Registered Agent
Consent to act as Company Secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC issues a query or requisition, the registered agent drafts a curative response or amends deficient documents (e.g., signature inconsistencies, defective share provisions) and re-files within 14 days. Failure to cure within the statutory period may result in deemed abandonment; a fresh application can be submitted without prejudice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtaining Certificate of Incorporation and Tax-Exempt Status Confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), registration desk; Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue (notification only)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, collect the Certificate of Incorporation and the Memorandum of Registration from VFSC or receive certified copies electronically. Confirm the company's tax-exempt status under the IC Act and note that no Vanuatu corporate income tax, withholding tax, or stamp duty applies to an International Company deriving income outside Vanuatu. The company is not automatically registered for VAT or business license taxes. Retain the certified charter documents in the registered agent's corporate registry.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate contains typographical or legal defects, request rectification by statutory declaration under IC Act s.70 with the original certificate. If any tax notification is erroneously issued, contact the Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue Commissioner to clarify the International Company tax-exempt status.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Governance and Payment Rails Setup
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors; VFSC-licensed registered agent (no government approval required for this step)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting and adopt the pro-forma first board resolution. Allot the subscribed shares, issue physical or electronic share certificates, and file the share register, directors' register, and registered agent register with the registered agent. Execute the merchant of record agreements with Paddle and Lemon Squeezy, and submit corporate KYC documentation to open the operating bank account or digital wallet in the company's name.
required_dossiers: Paddle / Lemon Squeezy merchant account application
Corporate bank or e-wallet account application with KYC pack
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a payment provider or bank rejects KYC, provide the VFSC Certificate of Incorporation and a certificate of good standing, and correct any beneficial ownership disclosure discrepancies. If the merchant underwriting criteria are not met, utilize an alternative Master Merchant Agreement through Paddle's reseller model or apply to Lemon Squeezy's curated review queue.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA), Ministry of Trade, Tourism, Industry and Commerce — applicable solely if the company establishes a physical office in Vanuatu; no sectoral industrial licensing body applies to pure cloud software operations under ISIC 6201.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No operating license or manufacturing permit required for consumer micro-SaaS subscription services in Vanuatu. Optional Foreign Investment Certificate (VIPA) may be obtained if the company later establishes a local physical presence or employs residents; remote digital operation with non-resident founders requires no license.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Vanuatu Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change Adaptation, Meteorology, Geo-Hazards, Environment, Energy and Disaster Management
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — Category 3 (no physical installation, no construction, no point-source discharge; digital-only service classified as environmentally inert).
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable: zero wastewater discharge, zero VOC emissions, and zero hazardous-waste generation from the SaaS operations. Where office waste or end-of-life electronics are generated, the company must comply with the Waste Management Act [Cap. 286] general waste handling rules and e-waste disposal obligations, and any future DEPC notice requiring a simple registration statement.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable for remote digital-only operations without physical premises. If the company later leases office space in Vanuatu, it must obtain a fire safety clearance from the Vanuatu Police Force Fire Service and an occupational workplace clearance from the Department of Labour under the Health and Safety at Work Act, including a structural load inspection certificate from the Public Works Department where commercial tenancy is established.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Department of Customs and Inland Revenue, Ministry of Finance and Economic Management, Port Vila, Vanuatu (tax administration portal: customsinlandrevue.gov.vu); offshore entity licensing and registration are administered separately by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) via its e-registry portal (vfsc.vu).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax, personal income tax, capital gains tax, or VAT, and therefore does not issue a TIN or VAT ID to non-resident International Companies (ICs). The IC's statutory fiscal identifier is the VFSC registration number obtained under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222] through a licensed agent; this number is used as the de facto taxpayer/entity identifier for bank onboarding, payment rails (Paddle, Lemon Squeezy), and foreign tax-residence attestation. No Inland Revenue registration, tax-return lodgement, VAT enrollment, or annual domestic tax filing is required for an IC that conducts business outside Vanuatu.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box, transparent-entity election, or hybrid-mismatch election exists under Vanuatu law. A foreign-owned IC may elect its permitted activity scope at incorporation by confirming (via VFSC Form) that all business is transacted outside Vanuatu; this statutory offshore election preserves the zero-tax treatment while avoiding the domestic business-licence tax. There is no other tax classification election available, and no hybrid instrument or PE election is recognized by the domestic legislation.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No_National_VAT_Or_GST (Vanuatu levies only customs duties, excise and statutory levies; no VAT/GST legislation is in force)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not Applicable — there is no VAT/GST statute, no turnover registration threshold, and no VAT registration process for micro-SaaS subscription arrangements in Vanuatu.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Not Applicable — Vanuatu operates no real-time fiscal clearance, no e-invoicing API, no digital stamping, and no continuous transaction control (CTC) framework. Commercial invoices issued via Stripe/Paddle/Lemon Squeezy are accepted as ordinary commercial records; import duty formalities arise only for physical goods, not for digital code delivered electronically.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not Applicable — there is no VAT/GST to zero-rate. Cross-border SaaS revenues of the IC are entirely outside the Vanuatu tax net as foreign-source and intangible; entitlement to the effective 0% rate arises by operation of law (legislative absence), not by application. The IC should retain subscription contracts, payment-rail payout reports, and customer-location evidence (IP address/card billing country) to substantiate the foreign character of supply and to meet counterparty KYC in high-tax destinations.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Not Applicable for intangible SaaS supplies — Vanuatu imposes no customs export declaration or fiscal clearance on electronically delivered software; the IC maintains commercial evidence only (contracts, payout ledger, and customer jurisdiction records).

If residual tangible assets are ever exported from Vanuatu, the customs bundle is: outward customs declaration (Customs Act [Cap. 157]), transport document (Bill of Lading or Air Waybill), and banking receipt evidencing inward/outward remittance of export proceeds.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: There is no Vanuatu VAT refund or export zero-rating mechanism, hence no VAT clawback exposure for the IC. Customs-fraud false declarations are punishable under the Customs Act [Cap. 157] (forfeiture, fines and, in aggravated cases, imprisonment); false statements to the VFSC risk monetary penalties, strike-off, and director disqualification under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]. In practice, tax audit scrutiny is limited to accuracy of the offshore-activity attestation; the principal clawback risk arises from the beneficial-owner's residence country applying CFC, permanent-establishment, or substance rules, not from Vanuatu's own regime.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), acting as the central bank and delegated exchange control administrator under the Exchange Control Act [Cap. 65], jointly administered with the Vanuatu Ministry of Finance; licensed commercial banks in Vanuatu operate as authorized dealers for all foreign exchange transactions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vanuatu Vatu (VUV) operates under a managed-float regime referenced to a composite basket of AUD, USD, EUR, and JPY. Current-account convertibility is liberalized: cross-border service fees, software subscription receipts, and profit/dividend remittances may be executed through authorized dealers without prior central bank pre-approval when within delegated thresholds. Capital-account transactions, including inbound equity injections, non-resident borrowings, and treasury placements, require authorized-dealer approval or prior RBV permission above stipulated limits. The Vanuatu International Company (IC) benefits from statutory exemption from Vanuatu corporate income tax and withholding tax on dividends under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222], but profit remittance to non-resident shareholders still requires exchange-control reporting, an authenticated board resolution, audited or accountant-certified financial statements, and AML/KYC evidence of the ultimate beneficial owners. Convertibility risk is moderate given the small depth of the onshore VUV market; full conversion of USD receipts to VUV is freely available for operational funding, while USD retention in onshore foreign-currency accounts is permitted under authorized-dealer standing rules.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under the Exchange Control Act [Cap. 65] and subsidiary regulations, all export proceeds, including cross-border receipts from digital services and SaaS subscription sales, must be repatriated to Vanuatu through an authorized dealer within six (6) months of payment receipt. The foreign currency must be offered for sale to the authorized dealer, with the standard statutory conversion ratio being 100% of export proceeds, unless an express exemption or retention permission is granted by the RBV. In current banking practice, authorized dealers permit an IC to retain USD in a designated foreign-currency clearing account for subsequent outbound trade disbursements where a monitorable export revenue schedule and standing surrender election are filed; conversion to VUV is then limited to amounts required for local expenditure, statutory fees, and regulatory obligations. The micro-SaaS subscription collections from Paddle and Lemon Squeezy must therefore be swept via SWIFT MT103 into the IC's onshore Vanuatu USD account, with the retention election documented with the bank and reconciled quarterly to satisfy the six-month surrender timeline.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of South Pacific (BSP) Vanuatu Limited
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (VUV/USD) with designated USD foreign-currency clearing sub-account; Capital Escrow/Share Subscription Deposit Account
Operational Account (VUV/USD); Capital Escrow/Share Capital Deposit Account
Operational Current Account (VUV/USD); Foreign-Currency Settlement Account
Retail savings account only; not suitable for International Company treasury or foreign-currency clearing operations

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low feasibility. Offshore digital EMI platforms, including Wise Platform, Airwallex, Currenxie, Payoneer, and similar payment-facilitation entities, generally decline entity KYB for jurisdiction code VU because of Vanuatu's FATF grey-list status, thin correspondent-bank appetite, and the exchange-control prohibition on holding foreign receipts indefinitely outside Vanuatu. Paddle and Lemon Squeezy, as Merchant of Record, do not provide the IC with a bank account but remit settlement proceeds via SWIFT MT103 to the IC's onshore account. Any offshore EMI collection arrangement would require an express RBV authorized-dealer exemption and would still attract enhanced due diligence under the AML/CFT Act; therefore the recommended compliant architecture is direct SWIFT settlement from the Merchant of Record to a Vanuatu licensed commercial bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: The Vanuatu AML/CFT Code and Banking Act regulatory standards require face-to-face identity verification for all non-resident beneficial owners and authorized signatories; however, the major banks currently permit a remote videoconference KYC interview where (i) the director's passport and government-issued ID are notarized by a notary in the country of residence, (ii) apostilled or consular-legalized IC corporate documents are provided (Certificate of Incorporation, Certificate of Good Standing, Register of Directors and Shareholders), (iii) a professional reference letter from the director's home-country relationship bank is supplied, and (iv) the VFSC-licensed registered agent physically lodges the introduction file at the bank in Port Vila. A physical appearance in Port Vila by the first authorized signatory is strongly recommended to accelerate approval and to mitigate correspondent-bank de-risking; banks retain the discretion to mandate an in-person compliance interview if the IC has any ultimate beneficial owner resident in a FATF grey-listed, EU non-cooperative, or sanction-monitored jurisdiction.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Vanuatu FATF grey-list jurisdiction flag and correspondent-bank de-risking; the IC is presumed higher-risk without demonstrable legitimate industry evidence.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: VFSC Certificate of Good Standing; IC annual return filing receipt; tax-exemption certificate under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]; the registered agent's licensed KYC file; an independent third-party KYB report on the IC; home-country bank reference letter with at least 12 months of transaction history; product website and SaaS live-service evidence; and a written treasury narrative explaining the Merchant-of-Record settlement model.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opaque beneficial ownership, including nominee shareholders, bearer shares, or undisclosed trust structures, flagged as AML red-flag.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete registered and beneficial ownership matrix identifying each ultimate natural person; certified copies of passports and proof of residential address for all UBOs; source-of-wealth and source-of-funds declarations for the subscribed capital; executed declaration of trust or nominee agreement if any nominee is used; and a current extract from the VFSC beneficial-ownership register.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume, small-value cross-border consumer subscription payments from diverse geographies, potentially mischaracterized as money-mule flows.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Paddle and Lemon Squeezy settlement statements; API-exported billing ledger showing real consumer subscriptions; product website, public pricing page, and software repository; registered trademark or IP filing certificate; standard terms of service and privacy policy; invoice templates; and a revenue-attribution model mapping monthly subscription counts to bank deposits.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Exchange-control mismatch where foreign-currency receipts are not surrendered or retained under an authorized-dealer standing instruction, creating suspicious credit patterns.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A filed export-proceeds surrender/retention election form; the bank's standing instruction to sweep USD receipts into the onshore USD clearing account; a quarterly reconciliation schedule of Merchant-of-Record settlements; RBV declaration forms (including the bank's exchange-control event form where applicable); and an annual treasury compliance letter signed by the IC's appointed auditor or independent accountant.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The promoter or investing shareholder remits initial subscribed capital from a home-country bank account via SWIFT MT103 to the IC's designated USD capital deposit account at BSP Vanuatu, ANZ Vanuatu, or BRED Vanuatu, with payment field 70 carrying a clear purpose code such as 'IC SUBSCRIPTION CAPITAL — ISSUE OF SHARES' and the VFSC IC registration number. The authorized dealer simultaneously obtains the board resolution authorizing the share issuance, the share allotment register, the source-of-funds bank statements, and a UBO declaration. Inbound amounts exceeding the authorized-dealer de minimis threshold are reported under the Exchange Control Act via the bank's RBV declaration form; no statutory minimum paid-in capital applies to a Vanuatu IC, but maintaining declared issued capital of at least USD 10,000 is the prudent banking standard to avoid empty-shell classification. The IC must preserve SWIFT confirmation messages, exchange-control deposit receipts, and the VFSC annual return filings as a full audit trail.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound treasury payments for trade settlement are executed exclusively via SWIFT MT103 from the IC's VUV/USD operational account at a Vanuatu authorized-dealer bank. Payments to global SaaS vendors, cloud infrastructure providers (AWS, Google Cloud, Cloudflare), software licensors, and affiliate marketing networks use UN/EDIFACT purpose codes such as '131' (other services) or '842' (subscription/licensing fees) as directed by the bank's compliance team. Merchant-of-record settlements from Paddle and Lemon Squeezy flow inbound as MT103 credits from the MoR settlement bank and are matched against the export revenue schedule. Dividend distributions to non-resident shareholders are remitted via MT103 supported by audited or accountant-certified IC financial statements, the VFSC solvency and annual return filings, and the exchange-control remittance form. A commercial Letter of Credit is not relevant to a micro-SaaS treasury model and is reserved for high-value physical-goods transactions; the standard clearing rail is the Swift MT103 network with full AML/OFAC screening and exchange-control recording for every outbound payment above the authorized-dealer threshold.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable VUV/USD forward contracts, up to 12 months tenor, executed with a licensed Vanuatu authorized-dealer commercial bank and collateralized by the IC's USD operational deposit

Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) referencing VUV, permitted only where an express RBV exchange-control exemption has been granted to the IC; otherwise prohibited as a breach of the Exchange Control Act [Cap. 65]

Cross-currency swaps (VUV/USD) and related rate hedges, available only for treasury-scale exposures exceeding USD 1 million, executed with an authorized-dealer bank subject to prior RBV capital-account approval

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Registrar of International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within two calendar months after each anniversary of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty plus fine of up to VT 100,000 (approx. USD 850); continued non-filing permits the Registrar to strike off the company after 28 days' notice.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory statutory audit for an International Company under the International Companies Act 1992; an audit may be required only if shareholders pass an ordinary resolution requesting one.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Voluntary audited financial statements prepared in accordance with IFRS or such acceptable accounting framework as the directors resolve; no statutory accounting standard is prescribed for International Companies.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Vanuatu maintains no public UBO register. The licensed registered agent must keep current beneficial ownership records verified on a risk-basis and updated on any share transfer or material control change. For shareholding transfers, directors' consent must be recorded, the Register of Members revised, and the next Annual Return filed with updated shareholding details.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% (nil) - Vanuatu does not levy corporate income tax on International Companies.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: The Vanuatu International Company is statutorily tax-exempt on all non-Vanuatu-source income. There is no capital gains tax, no payroll tax, no social security contribution, no stamp duty on share transfers and no withholding tax on dividends, interest or royalties paid by an IC. A consumer Micro SaaS exporter deriving subscription revenue solely from non-resident end users through merchant-of-record platforms such as Paddle or Lemon Squeezy incurs zero effective Vanuatu tax. VAT at 12.5% is confined to domestic supplies of goods and services made in Vanuatu, and exported digital services are zero-rated, so the IC suffers no Vanuatu VAT leakage.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No corporate income tax return exists. The only compulsory annual filing for a Vanuatu International Company is the VFSC Annual Return, submitted through the licensed registered agent in Port Vila via the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) e-Services portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within six months after the annual registration anniversary date; the first Annual Return is due no later than 18 months after incorporation. There is no tax assessment, estimation, prepayment or final-return cycle because no corporate income tax is imposed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box A - Name and registration number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full legal name, VFSC International Company number and date of incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the exact name stated on the Certificate of Incorporation; no Vanuatu tax identification number or non-resident permit is required.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box B - Registered office and registered agent
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical street address of the registered office in Vanuatu and the name of the licensed registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The Port Vila registered agent completes this box; the foreign shareholder may remain undisclosed on the public Annual Return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Names, addresses, nationality and shareholdings of current directors and shareholders as recorded in the company register.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Nominee directors and offshore shareholders are lawful. Beneficial ownership particulars are retained by the registered agent for AML/CFT compliance and VFSC inspection, but are not inserted on the face of the Annual Return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorised and issued share capital, number of shares, par value (if any) and consideration paid.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: An IC has no minimum capital requirement; a nominal issued capital of USD 1 or equivalent in VUV is sufficient.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statement by a director or the registered agent that the IC has complied with the International Companies Act and maintains its records at the registered office.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The registered agent may execute the declaration; no notarisation, apostille or appearance by the foreign shareholder is required.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing attracts VFSC late fees on top of the annual maintenance fee, with graduated monthly surcharges for continued default. Three consecutive years of default lead to automatic strike-off of the IC, dissolution of the company, vesting of its assets in the Registrar, and criminal liability for any director who continues trading after strike-off. The Registrar may also impose a statutory monetary penalty on the IC and on each officer for violations of the International Companies Act.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Value Added Tax Return (prescribed VAT return form) filed online through the Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue e-filing portal. This obligation is conditional and is triggered only where the IC makes taxable supplies to Vanuatu-resident customers rather than pure foreign SaaS subscriptions.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Quarterly (calendar quarters), with an optional monthly filing cycle upon approval of the Commissioner.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due on or before the last day of the month immediately following the end of the tax period, roughly 30 days after the close of each quarter.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 1 - Taxable supplies at standard rate
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total VAT-exclusive value of standard-rated supplies made in Vanuatu, including SaaS subscriptions supplied to Vanuatu residents.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Leave nil where Paddle or Lemon Squeezy acts as merchant of record, or where all subscription revenue is received from non-resident customers.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Value of supplies that are VAT-exempt under the Vanuatu VAT Act, such as qualifying financial services.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Generally not applicable to a consumer Micro SaaS business.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Value of exported services, including digital SaaS delivered to consumers outside Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Where the IC invoices directly and the recipient is non-resident, classify revenue here; zero-rated export supplies do not attract output VAT.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: VAT charged to the company on purchases of goods or services used for making taxable supplies.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Usually nil for an offshore IC that purchases hosting, legal and payment processing services outside Vanuatu or through a merchant-of-record gross-up gateway.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 5 - Net VAT payable or credit
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computed output VAT less input VAT; payment accompanies the return.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Typically zero for a Micro SaaS exporter. In a foreign merchant-of-record model, the platform remits all consumer VAT/GST in the end-customer jurisdiction and no Vanuatu VAT entry is made.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing subjects the IC to a fixed default penalty, a daily continuation surcharge, and interest on any unpaid VAT. Failure to register while making taxable supplies carries a penalty of up to 200% of the VAT evaded plus interest; deliberate evasion may lead to criminal prosecution of the responsible director, with additional fines and custodial penalties.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% (nil). Vanuatu does not enact a dividend withholding tax, and an International Company may distribute all profits to a non-resident shareholder free of any Vanuatu tax, exchange control or balance-of-payments restriction.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has no domestic income tax and virtually no comprehensive double tax treaty network, so a domestic DTA relief claim procedure does not exist in Vanuatu. Where a counterpart jurisdiction nevertheless requires tax residency proof or a Tax Residency Certificate (TRC), the beneficial owner must (i) obtain a Certificate of Good Standing from the VFSC, (ii) obtain a certified copy of the Certificate of Incorporation of the IC, (iii) obtain from the registered agent a certificate identifying the IC's place of effective management and board control, and (iv) submit these documents directly to the foreign payer's tax authority under the standard TRC application protocol. Foreign anti-abuse safeguards - beneficial ownership, economic substance, principal purpose and conduit rules - must be satisfied; a letter-box Vanuatu IC will normally fail such tests.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Vanuatu statutory withholding tax on outbound royalties and interest is 0% (nil). Because Vanuatu lacks comprehensive double tax agreements with the major SaaS consumer markets, no lower treaty rate can be invoked; source-state domestic withholding rules (such as U.S. backup withholding and EU interest-royalty treatment) remain the operative compliance risk and should be addressed at the payment-platform and corporate-structure level.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable - Vanuatu enacts no transfer pricing statute and therefore imposes no Local File or Master File obligation measured in VUV. For defensibility in the beneficial owner's home jurisdiction, where the SaaS IP and commercial management may reside, a prudent minimum threshold is to retain a benchmarking or transfer pricing study once intercompany transactions exceed 30,000,000 VUV (approximately USD 250,000) per annum, even though no Vanuatu law requires it.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu's economic substance legislation imposes a local substance test only on companies carrying on defined relevant activities, including banking, insurance, shipping, fund management, financing and leasing, headquarters, distribution and service centre, pure equity holding and intellectual property holding. A consumer Micro SaaS operator that derives its revenue from SaaS subscriptions, rather than from royalties on a separately held IP portfolio, falls outside the IP-holding head, and no Vanuatu economic substance test applies. The IC remains tax-exempt under the International Companies Act, and its only local presence is the registered office and agent. If the IC were later converted into a pure IP holding vehicle, or if it received passive royalties from related entities, the IP-holder substance rules would require locally staffed core income-generating activities, physical premises and adequate local expenditure, which are practically difficult for a letter-box IC. In addition, EU and OECD anti-haven screening, FATF monitoring and the beneficial owner's own CFC, economic substance and general anti-abuse rules must be assessed independently because they operate on top of the Vanuatu domestic exemption.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Foreign Tax Evasion and Sham Corporation Abuse
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The non-resident beneficial owner incorporates a Vanuatu IC, operates the software business entirely from a high-tax home jurisdiction, and fails to declare the SaaS profits on the home tax return, asserting that the IC is the taxpayer even though the IC has no staff, no commercial functions and no management substance in Vanuatu.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The home tax authority disregards the IC as a sham, assesses the beneficial owner on the worldwide SaaS profits, applies negligence or intentional evasion penalties commonly ranging from 25% to 200% of the evaded tax, imposes interest, and may commence criminal tax-fraud proceedings. Under exchange-of-information arrangements, Vanuatu corporate and registry records of the IC and the beneficial owner are obtainable on lawful request.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Shareholders and de facto directors face joint and several liability for the underlying corporate tax under foreign general anti-abuse rules. Travel bans, asset-restraint orders and extradition may be issued; punishment for deliberate fraud typically ranges from 12 months to 14 years imprisonment, alongside personal restitution orders.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Strike-Off and Loss of Corporate Shield / Shell Company
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The IC intentionally has no registered agent, no registered office, no filed Annual Returns, and one common nominee director, and is used solely as a payment pass-through from Paddle and Lemon Squeezy while maintaining no books or records in Vanuatu.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the International Companies Act and the VFSC fee schedule, non-payment and non-filing attract late fees and daily surcharges. The Registrar may strike the IC off the register; the company is dissolved on default, its assets vest in the Registrar, and continued trading after strike-off is a statutory offence. The IC's merchant and bank accounts are frozen in practice when VFSC notifies payment processors and correspondent banks.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors remain personally liable for debts incurred after dissolution or where the company traded while insolvent. Foreign payment platforms and creditor jurisdictions apply quasi-veil-piercing: the beneficial owner and nominee directors are jointly sued for refunds, chargebacks and fraud where the IC is found to be a mere cloak.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The Micro SaaS IC is used as a money-movement device: subscription collections are swept from the merchant account to a personal offshore account, funds are shared with unrelated third parties, high-volume same-day withdrawals occur, or customers are located in sanctioned jurisdictions, and no customer due diligence or suspicious-transaction reporting is undertaken.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: A breach of the Vanuatu AML/CTF legal framework can attract criminal fines up to 50,000,000 VUV and imprisonment up to 15 years for aggravated offences; enforcement agencies may seize the IC's accounts, grant recovery orders and initiate disqualification proceedings. Internationally, OFAC or FATF measures can list the entity, freeze correspondent banking relationships, and cause payment processors to terminate the merchant account with indefinite reserve withholding.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who operate an unlicensed money-service business, sign sham loan agreements or conceal the ultimate beneficial owner are personally prosecutable. Personal bankruptcy petitions, cross-border asset freezes and travel bans are customary; the Vanuatu corporate veil is pierced where the IC is the instrumentality of fraud or money laundering.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Fraudulent Invoice Scheme / Trade-Based Transfer Pricing Abuse
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The IC issues marketing, consulting or software-licence invoices to connected high-tax operating companies for purported SaaS services; related payers claim tax deductions, but no actual development, hosting or support is performed by the IC, and no arm's-length benchmark supports the retained margin.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The foreign tax administration disallows the related-company deductions, reattributes the IC margin under CFC, GILTI, transfer pricing or general anti-abuse rules, and levies gross-up penalties commonly from 30% to 150% of the additional tax, plus interest. The IC is also exposed to VFSC scrutiny because the invoices contradict the registered-object clause and the record-keeping requirements of the International Companies Act.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who approve false invoices or intercompany agreements are exposed to tax-fraud charges in the payer jurisdiction. Personal civil restitution is ordered for disgorgement of inflated margins; in cross-border criminal proceedings, directors may be extradited, subjected to travel bans and sentenced to imprisonment applicable to false accounting, commonly from 1 to 14 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The IC sells subscriptions directly to Vanuatu-resident consumers or to business users in markets where it is deemed to have a fixed establishment, but deliberately suppresses VAT/GST registration, charges no consumption tax, and instructs the merchant of record (Paddle or Lemon Squeezy) to misroute revenue as exported services despite the customer's local VAT address.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Vanuatu VAT Act, deliberate non-registration and under-remittance attract a civil penalty of up to 200% of the VAT due plus monthly interest; foreign digital-services tax and VAT/GST regimes impose comparable failure-to-register and accuracy penalties on both the platform and the IC. Pursuit of shadow-economy software vendors includes deregistration and criminal referral.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: VAT statutes in Vanuatu and major consumer markets contain director-liability clauses: a responsible director who authorised the evasion is jointly and severally liable from personal assets for the unpaid VAT, and where fraud is proved, the applicable custodial sentence is up to 12 months in Vanuatu and up to 7 years in some OECD jurisdictions.
